description: DRAFT — derived from the S2UI/1 specification, spec/S2UI-1.md §5 (the command set: answer_attention, approve_run, stop_run, check_run_state). No S2UI command tool ships in the reference implementation yet. Every command is idempotency-keyed and authorised server-side per run. The envelope standardises the request shape, never the permission.

answer.description: For answer_attention / approve_run: the chosen answer, e.g. approved, denied, or free text for a question.

attentionId.description: Required in practice for answer_attention; names the stable attention id from the RunDigest.

expectedSeq.description: For consequential commands: the digest seq the caller acted on. The server re-checks current state (check_run_state) before acting; a mismatch is a refusal, not a guess.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated unique key. Replaying the same key MUST NOT perform the action twice.

requestedBy.description: Identity the server records in its audit log (who, action, runId, attentionId). The server MUST NOT trust this field for authorisation.

_draft.description: Draft-package marker, examples only. MUST NOT be emitted by production code.

title: S2UI Command Envelope v1 — DRAFT
